jobs.title: Associate Director, Government Partnerships
jobs.content:
<p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Code for America believes government can work for the people, by the people, in the new digital age, and that government at all levels can and should work well for all people. For more than a decade, we’ve worked to show that with the mindful use of technology, we can break down barriers, meet community needs, and find real solutions.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Our employees build and transform government and community tools and services, making them so good they inspire change.
